title: fix: bill streamed prompt cache writes
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds `cache_write_tokens` to Chat completion usage validation
- Preserves streamed cache-write usage through tracking and billing
- Adds an integration test for Tinybird token attribution and the exact wallet debit

Tests:
- `vitest run test/tracking-observability.test.ts test/usage-headers.test.ts`
- `npm run typecheck`

gist.headline: The cache keeps receipts
gist.blurb: Streamed chat cache writes now make it all the way through the hive ledger. Polli found the missing token jar and put it back on the billing shelf.
gist.summary: Added `cache_write_tokens` to OpenAI chat-completion usage validation so streamed prompt-cache writes are preserved in Tinybird attribution and wallet billing.
gist.impact: Developers using streamed chat completions now get accurate usage tracking and wallet debits for prompt-cache write tokens.
gist.visual_concept: Depict streamed token packets flowing from a retro chat terminal into labeled cache jars, then into a tidy wallet ledger. Polli, wearing a tiny accountant visor, checks the cache-write token count while the eager CRT monitor robot confirms that every token has been attributed; small code-plants and flowers make the accounting nook feel like part of the garden.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny accountant visor, carefully counting glowing streamed token packets flowing from a retro chat terminal into a jar labeled in simple pixel text: 'CACHE WRITE'. A cute CRT monitor robot holds a tiny wallet ledger beside lime green (#ecf874) code-plants and pastel flowers, with warm cream, mint, and lavender gradients; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic and emotionally warm.
